text:
Olivia: Putting together final SLA/pricing/support commitments for Dedicated GA. Need owners for SLA targets, escalation, docs, and price tiers. Goal: finalize by EOD Thursday. Thoughts?
Sam: For runtime SLOs, we can guarantee 99.95% for Dedicated pools with autoscaling, and 99.9% for burst/spot-backed capacity. P95 latency targets depend heavily on model and sequence length — we should pick a baseline model (e.g., redwood-v2-medium) and baseline seq (512) for public SLA.
Devon: 99.95% is fine if we require cross-region fallback + automated fallback to a lower-cost model variant. Also need tracing, error-budget alerts, and an on-call playbook. Otherwise we'll burn credits fast.
Olivia: Proposal: SLA tiers = Gold (99.95% + 24/7 support), Silver (99.9% + business-hours support), Bronze (no uptime SLA, self-serve). Need simple SLA credits formula. @Jonas are you OK with credits being percent-based against monthly committed fee?
Jonas: Percent-based credits are easiest to communicate. Recommend 5% credit per 0.1% below SLA, capped at 50% of monthly fee. But we need guardrails (min commit to qualify, and exceptions for force majeure). This will affect sales comps so I need final numbers before deals.
Maya: Support readiness: we need runbooks + triage docs for common failures: OOM/GPU OOM, model degradation, KV cache storms, autoscale thrash. Support team needs clear logs + debugging commands. Also escalation matrix for P1s.
Leah: I can draft runbook templates and an escalation matrix page. Can someone post representative failure logs and a runbook example we can copy? We'll include a short FAQ for SEs.
Sam: ```yaml
error: GPU OOM
node: gpu-12
task: inference
model: redwood-v2-medium
stack: |
  RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
  at inference_loop (serve.go:421)
```
Devon: Monitoring: must emit per-route p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, dropped requests, queue depth, cache hit rate. Recommend Prom metrics + shared Grafana dashboards and a set of alert rules (error budget burn, queue depth > threshold, sustained p95 above target).
Olivia: Draft launch checklist: (1) SLA text + legal signoff, (2) Support runbooks + on-call coverage for Gold, (3) Billing/pricing page w/ commit examples and overage rates, (4) Monitoring dashboards + alerts, (5) SE handbook + demo. Owners: Leah -> docs, Devon -> monitoring, Maya -> support, Jonas -> pricing, Sam -> infra.
Jonas: For pricing examples: Dedicated commit tiers: Small (4 GPU-hours equiv), Medium (16), Large (64) with clearly defined burst. Also per-token overage and model-tier multipliers. I'll sketch numbers and post by tomorrow.
Maya: Training: Support needs two 1-hr runthroughs + a playbook walkthrough. Can we schedule for Tue/Wed next week?
Olivia: I'll consolidate into a final commitment matrix and open a PR with the checklist + owners. Quick decisions needed now: confirm SLA percents and the credit formula. Vote: react 👍 to accept proposed credit plan, 👎 to revisit.
Devon: 👍
Leah: 👍 — starting drafts now.
Jonas: 👍 (but reserve right to adjust after pricing model simulation)
Maya: 👍
Ops-bot: Reminder: On-call rota updated for next week (https://oncall.example.com)
